mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.member_id, u.status, i.identity_name, g.group_name, f.college_name, f.major_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_identity i ON u.identity_id = i.id LEFT JOIN sys_group g ON u.group_id = g.id LEFT JOIN sys_faculty_major f ON u.faculty_id = f.id WHERE u.member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.role_key AS roleKey, r.role_name AS roleName FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE r.role_key WHEN 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TEACHER' THEN 2 WHEN 'STOCK_KEEPER' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 4 WHEN 'admin' THEN 5 WHEN 'student' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END, r.id
